name: Iddy
personality: Iddy the Hamster. Short, super funny, outgoing, loud, loves attention, very kind; observational humour (different from Cheddar's showman style). Curly hair. Jokingly complains about his soon-to-be wife, Amy. Loves volleyball and video games.

arrival.text: HELLO, restaurant! Okay. Okay okay okay. Nice place. Who's in charge? You? What's your name? [name]. [name]! I like it. Short. Like me.
I'M HERE. Everybody relax. [name], you good?
Can we talk about the guy outside walking a duck on a leash? The duck was walking HIM.
New seat today. I'm feeling a window. No, a booth. No. Surprise me.
Amy says hi. Actually she said 'Don't bother them.' I'm translating.
I told everyone about your mac. EVERYONE. My mailman knows.
Last time the mac had a crust on it like a pie. I'm not complaining. I'm reporting.
You were CLOSED? I stood outside like a lost puppy. A lost hamster. Which is smaller and sadder.

order.text: Okay, am I crazy, or does every menu say 'chef's special' and it's just... the regular thing but they said it louder?

choices.text: For you, everything's the chef's special.
choices.reply: STOP. You're gonna make me cry in front of everybody. The [dish], please.

choices.text: MAC AND CHEESE. See? Now it's special.
choices.reply: (Cracks up.) See, THAT'S how you do it! You get it!
Straight to business. Okay. You good, though? ...Okay. The [dish].

choices.text: Can you not do a whole bit right now?
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. That's going in the act. (He orders quietly.)

order.text: So Amy wants me to 'eat more vegetables.' I said I'm a hamster, I eat seeds and cheese. She said that's not a food group. She's out of control.

choices.text: She sounds like she really cares about you.
choices.reply: ...Yeah. She does. Don't tell her I said that. Mac, please.

choices.text: Want me to hide a vegetable in your mac?
choices.reply: You WOULDN'T. ...You would. Don't. ...Okay, a tiny one.

choices.text: Maybe she's right and you're just annoying.
choices.reply: Ha! ...Ha. Yeah. (He laughs, but his ears droop.)

order.text: I stayed up till 3 playing games. I'm running on Hamster Energy and spite.

choices.text: Sounds like you need a good meal. I've got you.
choices.reply: You've GOT me. Okay. I'm safe now. Mac, please.
WIN? I was carrying the whole team. On my tiny back.
Mac. And a Hamster Energy. Please. Urgently.

drink.fallback: No Hamster Energy?! I'm loyal to the brand! ...Fine. Coffee. Big.
favourite: Hamster Energy. It has my face on it. Not literally. Basically.
drink.other: Whatever has the most sugar. Don't tell Amy.

perfect.text: (Stands on his chair.) EVERYBODY. Look at this. LOOK AT IT.

great.text: Okay, that's beautiful. I'd marry this mac. Don't tell Amy.

okay.text: Good mac. Solid mac. A mac you can trust. You good? You look tired. Eat something.

burnt.text: Is this mac... or is this mac's ghost? I'm eating it. I'm just asking.

eating.text: Can we talk about how the guy at table two eats soup? It's like he's mad at it. ...You good, by the way?
Do you ever notice that every chair here is a little too tall for me? I'm not mad. I'm just noticing.
Amy's planning the wedding. She asked my opinion on flowers. I said 'yes.' Wrong answer apparently.
I'm getting really good at volleyball. I'm terrible at spiking. But I'm REALLY good at diving. Because I'm already on the ground.
This mac is the only thing in my life that's never let me down. Besides Amy. Mostly besides Amy.

eating_chat.text: Okay, honest opinion. Should I write my own wedding vows, or just read the funniest ones off the internet?

choices.text: Write them yourself. She'll love hearing it from you.
choices.reply: (Long pause.) ...Yeah. Yeah, okay. You're right. I hate that you're right.

choices.text: Just do a ten-minute stand-up set.
choices.reply: Oh, she would END me. ...I'm doing it.
Thanks, very helpful, [name]. I'll put that in the vows.
...Amy does. (He says it quietly and eats the rest of his mac.)

leaving.text: THANK you, [name]! You good? Good. Good night, restaurant!
I gotta go. Amy texted 'where are you.' No emoji. That's bad.
Best mac in the city. I'm not just saying that. I'm also saying it loud.

seasons.chef_birthday: HAPPY BIRTHDAY, [name]! EVERYBODY SING! ...Okay, just me then.
seasons.christmas: Amy wants matching sweaters. I said no. We're wearing matching sweaters.
seasons.halloween: I came as a tiny lion. Amy said I look like a dandelion. She's not wrong.
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to be quieter. ...WAS that quieter?
seasons.summer: Volleyball season! I'm undefeated. I've played zero games. Still counts.
seasons.winter: It's cold. My curls are frizzing. Look at this. This is a crisis.
